research.title: Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing 2025
research.subtitle: Built BERTopic/LDA models off of webscrapped papers for their 30th anniversary. Got to go on a fun trip to Hawaii for the conference.

research.title: Placenta Villi Clustering
research.subtitle: Used CV to cluster placenta villi to unify pathologist disagreement. Work eventually published in journal "Placenta".

research.title: AEOP PTSD Research
research.subtitle: I used deep learning to help create a non-biased PTSD detection model for the WRAIR. I really enjoyed my time there!

research.title: Art With Parkinson's
research.subtitle: My senior research project. This is inspired by my time teaching art at my grandma's retirement home. I used deep learning to create a corrective algorithm.

art.title: Creation
art.subtitle: They say the greeks painted their sculptures.

art.title: Observation One
art.subtitle: The other students at my old art studio.

art.title: Observation Two
art.subtitle: A storage closet in my old art studio.

art.title: The Bus Stop
art.subtitle: Grandma or young boy? I can't remember anymore.

art.title: The Person In The Mirror
art.subtitle: Self-reflection is difficult; self-awareness is a journey. In this piece, the figure gazing into the mirror is surprised by what she finds—is she really this angry?

art.title: Skin, Muscles, and Bones
art.subtitle: Underneath my face’s skin and muscles is just my skull. I wonder if my parents would be able to recognize me from a row of skulls.

art.title: Time's Grasp
art.subtitle: In Latin, we learned about the Fates, three older women who determined human destinies. I find myself thinking of these Fates anytime when I begin to feel the pressure of time.

art.title: She died as she lived. Independent
art.subtitle: The title is a quip on the fact that all her body parts are independent to each other.

art.title: A Fully Connected Neural Network
art.subtitle: In this self-portrait, I’m gazing up at this new, seemingly limitless version of machine learning in wonder and a twinge of fear: where will machine learning take us next?

misc.title: ATconnect
misc.subtitle: I initiated the first ATconnect event in 2025 connecting students and companies across the county to create and share their assistive technology with students with disabilities. I am proud that the club continued this event in 2026 and managed to reach over 140 people!
